outcome: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. caesarean section)
cohort: 135 women with uncertain gestational age at 42 weeks who underwent weekly CTG and AFI determinations at Tygerberg Hospital.
finding: Weekly monitoring with CTG and AFI at 42 weeks in women with uncertain gestational age is safe, but a follow-up visit after 2 weeks cannot be recommended as 8% of women required caesarean section within 2 weeks due to fetal distress.
